x.author: KanishDigital
x.body:
One simple hook to use in ads, is to call out the emotion that customer feels but use first person

Example
Pure oil fragrance brand 
"I get so frustrated with loud perfumes....."
"I feel let down when a perfume I loved is gone within the hour."

Hair care
"I feel embarrassed every time I see hair all over the shower floor."

Weight/fitness supplements
"I feel defeated starting over every single Monday."

Baby/mom brands
"I feel guilty that I can't always tell what's actually safe for my baby."
